_meta.purpose: Cached IUCN Red List + CITES/WPA status for ANVESH demo species set.
_meta.why_cached: IUCN API registration has lead time and the demo must not depend on a live external call. This file IS the conservation_status table content.
_meta.sources: IUCN Red List (redlist.org), CITES appendices, Wildlife Protection Act 1972 (as amended 2022) Schedule I/II/IV where applicable to Indian waters
_meta.demo_additions_2026_08_24: Of the original 18 species above, only Carcharhinus longimanus is actually in the live classifier's 500-species vocabulary (models/transformer/checkpoints/label_mapping.json) — the rest (whale shark, sea turtles, dugong, etc.) can never actually be predicted by the live model, so they can never really flag in a demo. The 3 entries appended at the end of this list (marked 'added for the demo dataset') were cross-checked against label_mapping.json specifically so a live upload can trigger real flags — see scripts/make_demo_dataset.py. Their IUCN categories were filled in from general/training knowledge, NOT a fresh redlist.org lookup like the original 18 — spot-check them on redlist.org before citing the exact category in a judged presentation. The species and the fact that they're real, trainable, threatened taxa is solid either way.
